name: @sage-protocol/openclaw-sage
description: OpenClaw Code Mode bridge for Sage prompts, skills, libraries, MCP tools, and value-network workflows

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p='dist/version.js'; fs.writeFileSync(p, fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').replace('__PKG_VERSION__', process.env.npm_package_version || '0.0.0'));"
scripts.test: node --import tsx src/skill-status-parse.test.ts && node --import tsx src/openclaw-skill-use.e2e.test.ts && node --import tsx src/mcp-bridge.test.ts && node --import tsx src/openclaw-hook.integration.test.ts
